finding: SIGINT immediately after handler installation can interrupt the setter before the old restoration dictionary is populated. The old context had not entered its finally yet.
original_behavior: Reproduced deterministically: previous SIGINT handler not restored.
fix: Register an ExitStack restoration before each install; disable only callbacks for installs rejected off the main thread. ExitStack runs remaining callbacks even if another raises.
regressions: interrupt during handler registration restores the old handler
non-main-thread guard does not restore uninstalled handlers
